description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the FeaturePropertyDeletedStrategy class in the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify the immutability of the strategy, correct application of feature property deletion events, and proper replacement of metadata within a 'Thing' object.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyDeletedStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeaturePropertyDeletedStrategy, verifying immutability, event handling, and metadata replacement.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the FeaturePropertyDeletedStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: appliesEventCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy correctly applies a FeaturePropertyDeleted event to a Thing, removing a feature property and updating_version and timestamps accordingly.

methods.name: replacesMetadataAtResourcePath
methods.description: Checks that the strategy replaces the correct metadata segment within a Thing when a FeaturePropertyDeleted event contains metadata updates.
